lonavala-trip.title: Lonavala Trip
lonavala-trip.subtitle: A Perfect Weekend Gateway!
lonavala-trip.leftHtml:
Get drivers who act as a guide

 

Lonavala is a beautiful hill station nestled in the Western Ghats, known for its lush greenery, scenic viewpoints, and pleasant weather. Perfect for a weekend getaway from Mumbai or Pune.

Important Information

  • ✓ Toll parking and entry tickets are not included in the car hire charges.
  • ✓ Remaining time and kms can't be use to cover local places in mumbai.  
  • ✓ The trip should be like :- ( Pickup - Lonavala - Khandala - Drop ).
  • ✓ City Tour Cabs offers door step pickup and drop for hassle free experience (No extra charge).
  • ✓ You can add or skip places of your choice. You can take your own time at each spot.
  • ✓ Cancellation charge  of Rs 500/- will be applicable if the booking is Cancelled after arrival of driver.
  •  

Top Attractions

  • 🌊 Bhushi Dam – A famous monsoon destination with scenic beauty.
  • ⛰️ Tiger Point – Stunning cliffside views, perfect for sunrise/sunset.
  • 🏛️ Karla Caves – Ancient Buddhist rock-cut caves.
  • 💧 Lonavala Lake – A serene and peaceful getaway.
  • 🛍️ Lonavala Market – Buy famous Chikki & local delicacies.
  • 🌳 Ryewood Park – A lush green garden for relaxation.
  • ⛰️ Khandala – Another beautiful hill station nearby.
  • 👁️ Lion's Point – One of the best viewpoints in Lonavala.
  • 🏤 Celebrity Wax Museum – First Wax Museum in India.
  • 🙏 Shree Narayani Dham Temple – Spiritual Retreat for Tourist.

matheran-sightseeing.title: Matheran Sightseeing
matheran-sightseeing.subtitle: India's Smallest Hill Station
matheran-sightseeing.leftHtml:

Matheran is Asia's only automobile-free hill station. Experience nature at its finest with stunning viewpoints, cool climate, and peaceful atmosphere.

Travel Information

  • ✓ Toll parking, and entry tickets are not included

Popular Viewpoints

  • 🌄 Echo Point – Famous for its echoing phenomenon.
  • 👫 Louisa Point – Romantic spot with valley views.
  • 🏔️ One Tree Hill Point – Iconic single tree viewpoint.
  • 🐎 Charlotte Lake – Peaceful lake surrounded by nature.
  • 🌳 Monkey Point – Highest point in Matheran.

    • ⛰️ Alexander Point – Most Scenic view point in Matheran.

    • 🏛️   Prabal Fort – Most Scenic view point in Matheran.

      • 🙏 Pisarnath Temple – Dedicated to Lord Shiv.

mahabaleshwar-sightseeing.title: Mahabaleshwar Sightseeing
mahabaleshwar-sightseeing.subtitle: The Queen of Hill Stations
mahabaleshwar-sightseeing.leftHtml:
Get drivers who act as a guide

 

Mahabaleshwar, situated in the Western Ghats, is famous for its stunning viewpoints, strawberry farms, and pleasant climate throughout the year.

Booking Details

  • ✓ Toll, parking, and entry tickets not included

  • 🏞️ Venna Lake – Boating and horseback riding activities.
  • 🍓 Mapro Garden – Famous for fresh strawberries and fruit products.
  • 🛕 Pratapgad Fort – Historic fort with panoramic views.
  • 🌅 Wilson Point (Sunrise Point) – Highest point in Mahabaleshwar.
  • 🌊 Dhobi Waterfall – Beautiful waterfall, best during monsoon.
  • 🍓 Strawberry Garden – Famous for fresh strawberries and fruit products.
  • 🏞️ Kate's Point – Praised for breathtaking views and serene atmosphere.
  • 🏛️ Panchganga Temple – Ancient temple dedicated to Lord Shiva.
  • 🌄 Connaught Peak – Second highest peak of Mahabaleshwar

igatpuri-tour.title: Igatpuri Tour
igatpuri-tour.subtitle: Hills, Waterfall & Dams
igatpuri-tour.leftHtml:
Get drivers who act as a guide

 

Igatpuri is a small hill town in the Western Ghats, located in Nashik district of Maharashtra. It’s best known for its scenic beauty, cool climate, and peaceful vibe especially popular with travelers from Mumbai and Pune looking for a quick nature getaway.

 

---------------------------------------------------

Important Information

 

  • ✓ Toll parking and entry tickets are not included in the car hire charges.
  • ✓ Remaining time and kms can't be use to cover local places in mumbai.  
  • ✓ The trip should be like :- ( Pickup - Igatpuri tour - Drop ).
  • ✓ City Tour Cabs offers door step pickup and drop for hassle free experience (No extra charge).
  • ✓ You can add or skip places of your choice. You can take your own time at each spot.
  • ✓ Cancellation charge  of Rs 500/- will be applicable if the booking is Cancelled after arrival of driver.

---------------------------------------------------

 

Top Attractions

 

 

🌄 Kasara Ghat – Scenic mountain pass with breathtaking valley views, especially during monsoon.

 

🕉️ Kapaleshwar Cave – A peaceful cave temple dedicated to Lord Shiva.

 

🙏Ghatandevi Mata Mandir – Surrounded by hills, perfect for a spiritual and nature-filled visit.

 

🚪Myanmar Gate – A grand entrance near Vipassana, inspired by Burmese architecture.

 

💧Ashoka Waterfall Vihigaon – A popular waterfall known for adventure activities like rappelling.

 

🌊 Bhavali Dam – Calm and scenic dam ideal for relaxing and photography.

 

🏰 Tringalwadi Fort – A trekking spot with panoramic views from the top.

 

⛰️ Camel Valley – Known for dramatic cliffs and seasonal waterfalls.

 

🌿 Bhatsa River Valley – A lush green valley with misty landscapes and river views.

 

🧘 Vipassana International Academy – World-famous meditation center offering a peaceful environment.

ashtavinayak.title: Ashtavinayak
ashtavinayak.subtitle: Spiritual Trail of Lord Ganesha
ashtavinayak.leftHtml:
Get drivers who act as a guide

 

Ashtavinayak refers to a sacred pilgrimage of eight temples dedicated to Ganesha, all located in the Indian state of Maharashtra. The word comes from “Ashta” (eight) and “Vinayak” (a name of Ganesha).

 

---------------------------------------------------

Important Information

 

  • ✓ Toll parking and entry tickets are not included in the car hire charges.
  • ✓ Remaining time and kms can't be use to cover local places in mumbai.  
  • ✓ The trip should be like :- ( Pickup -Ashtavinayak - Drop ).
  • ✓ City Tour Cabs offers door step pickup and drop for hassle free experience (No extra charge).
  • ✓ You can add or skip places of your choice. You can take your own time at each spot.
  • ✓ Cancellation charge  of Rs 500/- will be applicable if the booking is Cancelled after arrival of driver.

---------------------------------------------------

 

Top Attractions

 

 

Mayureshwar Temple (Morgaon)
Considered the starting and ending point of the yatra; Ganesha is said to have defeated the demon Sindhu here.

 

Siddhivinayak Temple (Siddhatek)
Known for granting wishes and success (siddhi).

 

Ballaleshwar Temple (Pali)
The only Ganesha temple named after a devotee (Ballal).

 

Varadavinayak Temple (Mahad)
Associated with blessings and boons (varada).

 

Chintamani Temple (Theur)
Believed to relieve worries (chinta).

 

Girijatmaj Temple (Lenyadri)
Located in caves; associated with Ganesha’s childhood.

 

Vighneshwar Temple (Ozar)
Worshipped as the remover of obstacles (vighna).

 

Mahaganapati Temple (Ranjangaon)
Represents Ganesha in his powerful form.

konkan-darshan.title: Konkan Darshan
konkan-darshan.subtitle: Beach, Forts & Hills
konkan-darshan.leftHtml:
Get drivers who act as a guide

 

A Konkan tour offers a scenic coastal escape along Maharashtra’s western coastline (approx. 720 km), characterized by pristine beaches, historic sea forts, coconut groves, and rich seafood.

 

---------------------------------------------------

Important Information

 

✓ Toll parking and entry tickets are not included in the car hire charges.

✓ Driver Allowance, Driver stay, Driver meals & Fuel charges are included.

✓ Remaining time and kms can't be use to cover local places in mumbai.  

✓ The trip should be like :- ( Pickup - Konkan tour - Drop ).

✓ City Tour Cabs offers door step pickup and drop for hassle free experience (No extra charge).

✓ You can add or skip places of your choice. You can take your own time at each spot.

✓ Cancellation charge  of Rs 500/- will be applicable if the booking is Cancelled after arrival of driver.

---------------------------------------------------

 

Places to Visit

🏖️ Velas Beach -  A peaceful, eco-friendly beach famous for its turtle conservation


🏰 Jaigad Fort -  A historic fort overlooking the Arabian Sea near the Shastri River.


🛕 Ganpatipule Temple - A famous pilgrimage site with a self-originated idol of Lord Ganesha


🏖️ Aare Ware Beach -  Twin beaches known for their scenic drive route and dramatic cliffs


🏰 Ratnadurg Fort - (Ratnadurg Killa) A massive fort surrounded by the sea on three sides

 

🏖️ Mandvi Beach - A clean and accessible beach in Ratnagiri town, ideal for casual walks and sunset views.

 

🏖️ Bhatye Beach -  A long, less crowded beach perfect for peaceful strolls and relaxing by the sea


🏛️ Thibaw Palace -  A historic palace where the exiled Burmese king lived.


🐟 Ratnagiri Marine Fish Museum -  A small but interesting museum showcasing marine life
